title: Lagrådet Critical Yttrande Frequency 2015–2025
description: Base-rate dataset recording the frequency at which Lagrådet (the Swedish Law Council) issues a kritisk yttrande (critical legal opinion) on government propositions. Used to anchor WEP probability assignments and DIW scoring for any analysis claim related to Lagrådet review outcomes. Covers riksmöten 2015/16 through 2025/26.
authority: ICD 203 §3.2 — base-rate anchoring for probabilistic claims; Heuer & Pherson SAT (3rd ed.) ch. 8

primary_sources.name: Lagrådet annual reports and yttranden archive
primary_sources.notes: Official primary-source archive of all Lagrådet opinions

primary_sources.name: Riksdag proposition register
primary_sources.notes: Used to count total propositions submitted for Lagrådet review

methodology: Count of propositions submitted to Lagrådet per riksmöte (source: riksdagen.se prop archive). Critical yttrande = Lagrådet-rated 'avstyrker' or 'kritiska anmärkningar av väsentlig karaktär'. Non-critical = 'tillstyrker', 'inga erinringar', 'lämnar utan erinran'. Partial critical = 'synpunkter' or 'påpekanden' without formal rejection.

aggregate_rates.annual_critical_rate_note: Proportion of propositions receiving at least one substantive critical opinion ('kritiska anmärkningar')
aggregate_rates.criminal_procedure_critical_rate_note: Propositions in criminal procedure / brottsbalken domain; historically higher critical rate than overall average
aggregate_rates.social_welfare_critical_rate_note: Social välfärd / socialtjänst domain; lower critical rate
aggregate_rates.constitutional_critical_rate_note: Grundlag / RF-amendment domain; highest critical rate
aggregate_rates.non_critical_rate_note: Proportion of all propositions receiving non-critical or no-objection opinion

annual_series.notable: Shortened riksmöte due to September 2018 election
COVID emergency legislation; elevated critical rate
Tidö government first year; criminal law reform focus

domain_breakdown.representative_yttrande: Lagrådet Dnr 2023-158 — kritiska anmärkningar on gang-crime law

calibration_notes: Base rate drifts ±3 pp year-over-year; use rolling 3-year mean for stable prior
Criminal-procedure domain is systematically above overall mean; apply domain-specific rate when claim scope is narrowly criminal
Emergency/expedited legislation (e.g. COVID 2020) shows critical rate 8–10 pp above normal — flag if rapid-legislation context applies
Partial-year riksmöten (election years) show lower total counts but similar critical rate
